generation.banner: AI-GENERATED ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - V2 - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED
generation.basis: 400 V (360-440 V) to 200 V / 25 A / 5 kW / 50 kHz synchronous buck; Wolfspeed C4MS025120K; TMS320F28335 control board on a stacked SELV mezzanine
net_class_pattern_deltas: A-G1: DESAT_H* / DESAT_L* moved from DRV_HS / DRV_LS (sic_buck_common) into the baseline classes DESAT_HS / DESAT_LS (each net belongs to exactly one class)
A-G1: SENSE_ISO patterns VIN_DIV* / VOUT_DIV* narrowed to VIN_DIV / VOUT_DIV; the ladder taps VIN_DIV_T* / VOUT_DIV_T1 (up to ~360 V) join HV_VIN / HV_VOUT

A-G1: HV intermediate nodes (sic_buck_power_model.HV_INTERMEDIATE_NETS) assigned by reference potential: BLD_IN_*, IND_IN_*, DAMP_MID -> HV_VIN; SNUB_MID -> HV_SW; PE_REF_MID -> HV_PGND; BLD_OUT_*, IND_OUT_* -> HV_VOUT
A-G1: CTRL_SELV lists every remaining power-board net explicitly (no net is left to Default)

A-G2: control board - CTRL_PWR (1.0 mm tracks) for 12V_IN, 12V_PROT, EFUSE_RTN, 5V, 5V_SW, 3V3, 1V9, 3V3_BULK, 1V9_BULK, GND_CTRL; CTRL_SELV for every other net; the shared HV patterns are carried as guards that must match nothing
generation.evidence: native ERC manifests under verification/erc/<run>/run.json; this record documents generation only
